Communist Propaganda - Result of Court Proceedings

Wei Tse-sun (魏子珍) who was arrested
on August 22, 1932 at house no.15, Lane 68,
Yu Kill Road, on charge of propagating communism
(Vide I.M.22.8.32), appeared before the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court on
August 30, when he was ordered to be released
on security.

Registry
Passed to You.
RB Sweet

1932年9月2日

共产主义宣传——法庭诉讼结果

魏子珍（Wei Tse-sun）于1932年8月22日在愚园路68弄15号因涉嫌传播共产主义而被捕（参见I.M. 1932年8月22日），于8月30日出庭江苏高等法院第二分院，当时被裁定取保释放。

登记室
转交阁下。
R.B. Sweet
1932年9月2日

Extract of Proceedings in S. S. D. Court for ______ 19__ F. I. R. No. __ SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. SUB. REGISTAR
Reg. No. E/66886 Stn. kilza Procurator ______ Judge ______
Stl. No. 44945
Fm. L. D. I. Revised 5-31. G. 100 m-5-31.

Sheet No. 3

Proceed-    Mr. Lee appeared for the S.M.C.
ings
            Mr. Lee:-The accused was arrested at 15 Burkill Rd. The police
searched this place and found that there was a communist organisa-
tion there. The accused has one previous conviction for the same
offence, but there is no direct proof that the accused committed a
further offence, so I ask leave to withdraw the writ of detention.
The representative of the P. Bureau is in Court and wishes that
the seized property will be handed over to them.
            The S.M.C. have no objection to this. Although the accused was
arrested in a communist organisation there is not any direct evi-
dence against him, but I ask the Court to order the accused before
being released to put up security so that if he commits a further
offence the police will be able to locate him. The police may also
find something against him in the near future.
            Rep. of P.S. Bureau, Dong Pan:-I only received notice of this case
today and as far as I know we have nothing against the accused.
I ask the Court to order the communist books and pamphlets seized
to be handed over to us.
            Accused:-Not questioned.

Decision    Allowed to be released on security.
            The judicial police is ordered to accompany accused outside in
order to IMMEDIATELY procure the security
            (Security not limited to shop security.
Ed.

S. M. Kuhl.

第3页

诉讼过程    李先生代表工部局出庭。
            李先生：被告在伯基尔路15号被捕。警方搜查了该处，发现那里有一个共产主义组织。被告此前曾因同一罪名被判刑，但没有直接证据证明被告犯了进一步的罪行，因此我请求撤回拘留令。公安局代表在庭，希望将查获的财物移交给他们。
            工部局对此无异议。虽然被告是在一个共产主义组织中被捕的，但并没有针对他的直接证据，不过我请求法庭命令被告在释放前提供担保，以便如果他再犯，警方能够找到他。警方也可能在不久的将来发现对他不利的证据。
            公安局代表，董潘（Dong Pan）：我今天才收到本案通知，据我所知，我们要对被告提出的指控并无实据。我请求法庭命令将查获的共产主义书籍和小册子移交给我们。
            被告：未受讯问。

判决        准予取保释放。
            命令司法警察陪同被告外出，以立即办理担保手续
            （担保不限于店铺担保。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of a letter received from Public Safety Bureau.

Character 政 No. 43. August 13, 1932.

Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.

I have to inform you that I have received a confidential instruction No. 105 from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai stating as follows:-

"A confidential letter has been received from the office of Special Pacification Commissioner in Honan to the effect that during a raid, a few days ago, on the Honan Provincial Headquarters of the Communistic Party, the following arrests were made:- Chi Kuo Tseng (纪国桢), Secretary of the Honan Provincial Headquarters and concurrently member of the C.E.C.; Yang S Bing (楊斯萍), Secretary General and Chief of the Women's Department; Tsu Foh Tseng (朱福楨), member of the Military Committee; Wong Lih Kong (王立綱) alias Wong Pah Yang (王伯羊), Secretary of the Honan Provincial Youth's Corps and more than ten members of the Central Communistic Party. They were handed over to Military Court for further investigations and interrogations."

"In a statement made by Wong Lih Kong, he said that his wife Yang Tse Ying (楊志英) had been invited to Shanghai by Lee Shao Hwa (李少華), Leader of the Communistic Bandits, for the purpose of undergoing training. They are now living in an upstairs room above the kitchen of Sing Kong Ziang Shop, Yoong Nyien Lee, Burkill Road, British Concession. We, therefore, write you with a request for their arrest and bringing them to justice."

"In view of the foregoing, this Municipality has to order the Chief of the Public Safety Bureau to act accordingly and submit a report."

Officers of this Bureau have made some confidential enquiries and proved the above mentioned facts to be true. Apart from applying for a warrant for their arrest from the 1st. Special District Court, I have to request that you will kindly detail police officers to be accompanied by bearer of this letter to the above mentioned address to make arrests of Lee Shao Hwa, Leader of the Communist Bandits, and Yang Tse Ying the wife of Wong Lih Kong alias Wong Pah Yang, to seize whatever reactionary matter found and to charge them before the said Court where an application for their extradition will be made by this Bureau.

Yours faithfully,
Wen Yin Sing.

政字第43号。1932年8月13日。

上海公共租界警务处总监：

兹通知阁下，本人已收到大上海市政府第105号密令，内容如下：

“近日收到河南绥靖公署来函称，数日前突袭共产党河南省党部时，逮捕了以下人员：纪国桢（Chi Kuo Tseng），河南省党部书记兼中央执行委员会委员；楊斯萍（Yang S Bing），秘书长兼妇女部部长；朱福楨（Tsu Foh Tseng），军事委员会委员；王立綱（Wong Lih Kong），化名王伯羊（Wong Pah Yang），河南省青年团书记以及十余名中共中央党员。他们已被移送军事法庭进行进一步调查和审讯。”

“据王立綱供述，其妻楊志英（Yang Tse Ying）受‘共匪’首领李少華（Lee Shao Hwa）邀请前往上海接受训练。他们现居住在英租界伯基尔路荣年里兴康祥店楼上厨房后的房间内。因此，特致函贵处，请求将其逮捕并绳之以法。”

“鉴于上述情况，本市政府命令公安局局长采取相应行动并提交报告。”

本局官员经秘密查访，证实上述事实属实。除向第一特区法院申请逮捕令外，恳请阁下指派警员，由持函人陪同前往上述地址，逮捕‘共匪’首领李少華及王立綱（化名王伯羊）之妻楊志英，搜缴所发现的一切反动材料，并在所述法院对其提起控告，本局将在该法院申请引渡他们。

此致
敬礼，
温应星（Wen Yin Sing）。

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 23/8/32

Communist Propaganda. - One Communist suspect arrested

Acting on the authority of a warrant issued by the Shanghai
Special District Court at the instance of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, the Municipal Police at 3.10 p.m. August 22
raided an upstairs back room of Chinese dwelling No.15, Lane 33,
Burkill Road, and seized a quantity of communist literature.
No persons were present at the time of the raid and as a result
of a watch maintained on the premises, a communist suspect
named Wei Tse-zung (魏子成) was apprehended at 8.30 p.m.
He has been placed on a writ of detention and will appear
before Court on August 23.

Req. Passed to S.M.

Li 先生：如果中国警方希望移交此人，他们必须提供一些证据证明他在租界外犯了罪。那两个人已经离开，这名被告仅因访问该处而因涉嫌被捕，警方目前对他没有任何指控。法庭只是希望在调查期间拘留此人，如果查询后发现对他不利的情况，稍后将提出指控。在没有提出针对他的证据的情况下移交此人违反先决条件，此外他的名字也不在逮捕令上，否则情况就完全不同了。
